meta.note: Factors are small and composable; compile_processes.py produces the per-company product. APQC ids are hints against PCF 7.2 cross-industry numbering; replace with parsed ids after ingesting the PCF files. Regional variants and product objects are from public vendor and regulator documentation; verify before shipping a pack.

order_to_cash.name: Order to Cash
activities: invoice equals delivered qty x price

acquire_to_retire.name: Acquire to Retire
activities: Register in asset ledger and CMDB

AU.e_invoicing: PEPPOL; Commonwealth agencies mandated, private voluntary

IN.e_invoicing: IRP e-invoice with IRN; mandatory above turnover threshold (INR 5 crore)

JP.e_invoicing: Qualified Invoice System (Oct 2023); PEPPOL JP PINT

KR.e_invoicing: e-Tax invoice via NTS (mandatory for corporations)
